legend: This proliferation of atypical, malignant B lymphocytes exhibits extensive interstitial infiltration with both atrophic and damaged cardiac myocytes.

An infiltrative mass is noted primarily along the inferolateral left ventricle, with smaller satellite foci along the anterior aspect of the ventricle; the tumour involves the epicardium, myocardium, and endocardium.
A malignant hematolyphoid proliferation extends transmurally throughout the heart. The involvement is often most pronounced in the pericardium.
